text.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām launching the verified proof sequence
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) joins the following verification particle to make the opening more than a report. It launches the whole verse as oath-like, settled testimony before messengers, proofs, book, balance, and iron are named.

topics.headline: oath-like certified opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah open as certified testimony before the provisions are listed.
topics.reason: The rows converge on initial lām plus qad plus perfect verb as an emphatic launch that frames the coordinated proof sequence.

words.gloss_range: verification particle making the first perfect verb rhetorically settled
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) certifies the first perfect verb and lets the later purpose clauses stand on an accomplished divine act. Its launch position colors the coordinated sequence as evidence already established.

topics.headline: verified completed act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending is treated as completed proof, not a hoped-for future act.
topics.reason: The rows align on qad with a perfect verb, strengthened by the preceding lām, as both completion and truth-certification.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect first-person plural dispatch of messengers
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatch, message, and messenger field, locally selected as causative divine commissioning
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalna}}) carries divine agency inside the first-person plural perfect under the opening la-qad certification and begins the r-s-l chain. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field is not loose motion here; Form IV makes the messengers commissioned agents whose mission will be bracketed by support for messengers near the close.

topics.headline: divine commissioning begins the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verse begin with direct divine commissioning that later returns in the messenger-support test.
topics.reason: Grammar, morphology, and internal echo rows all support a completed causative sending that governs the messenger object and opens the verse architecture.

words.gloss_range: accusative possessed plural as the object of sending
words.root_gloss_range: messenger/message/sending range, locally narrowed to the plural envoy object authorized by the divine possessive suffix
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلَنَا}} ({{tr:rusulana}}) is the dispatched object of the opening verb: a plural envoy body marked by the possessive suffix. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) range lets mission, message, and messenger press together, while the local grammar keeps the word as the authorized messenger object; the accepted rusl recitation changes sound weight, not the referent.

topics.headline: messengers owned by the sender
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the envoys as a divinely possessed plurality, not independent religious figures.
topics.reason: The rows about object position, possessive suffix, plural form, r-s-l echo, and qiraat survive, with the recitational rows limited to phonetic reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching the proof phrase to messenger sending
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens the proof phrase and attaches it back to the sending of the messengers. It can sound as accompaniment and instrument at once: the messengers come with proofs, and their mission is carried by proofs.

topics.headline: proofs as accompaniment and instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proofs travel with the sending rather than appearing as a detached list item.
topics.reason: The rows agree that the preposition governs the proofs and attaches them to the sending/messenger frame.

words.gloss_range: definite plural clear proofs governed by the preceding preposition
words.root_gloss_range: clarity and separation range, locally active as evidences that make truth distinct
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinat}}) is definite and plural, so the first provision is not a vague miracle category but recognizable evidentiary manifestations. The {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) root keeps clarity tied to separation: the proofs clarify by making a boundary visible, continuing the surah's manifestation theme (57:9, 57:12, 57:13, 57:17, 57:20).

topics.headline: proofs that make distinction visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the signs as recognizable proofs that separate truth from confusion.
topics.reason: The rows support definiteness, plural evidence, b-y-n clarity/separation, messenger-proof formula, and concrete same-surah echoes.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking messenger sending to the first descent clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) connects the messenger-sending clause to the first descent clause without making a new scene. The proof list accumulates: mission and descended instruments are parallel provisions under one divine agency.

topics.headline: mission and descent coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sending messengers and sending down instruments remain distinct but connected acts.
topics.reason: The rows identify simple coordination between the arsalna and anzalna clauses.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect descent governing the book and balance as paired objects
words.root_gloss_range: descent and lodging range, locally used for decisive divine delivery of guidance instruments
words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلْنَا}} ({{tr:anzalna}}) governs both the book and the balance, making text and measure a paired descent with the messengers. The {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) root spatializes provision from God to human order, and this first messenger-accompanied descent will be answered by the later descent of iron.

topics.headline: one descent for book and balance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees scripture and measure as divinely delivered together, not as separate human inventions.
topics.reason: The rows converge on Form IV perfect first-person plural, paired objects, repetition with word 19, and the Book/Balance justice infrastructure.

words.gloss_range: accompaniment adverb with plural suffix referring to the messengers
words.root_gloss_range: withness and accompaniment range, locally tied to the messenger plural by suffix reference
words.prose: {{ar:مَعَهُمُ}} ({{tr:maahum}}) binds the first descent to the messenger company through its plural suffix. The word makes book and balance travel with prophetic mission, and its absence from the later iron descent sharpens the difference between messenger-mediated guidance and material provision.

topics.headline: descent with the messengers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that book and balance are co-delivered with embodied messengers, unlike the later iron descent.
topics.reason: The rows support suffix reference to the messengers, attachment to the first descent, binding of both objects, and contrast with the second descent.

words.gloss_range: definite singular Book as the first object of the descent verb
words.root_gloss_range: writing and prescribing range, with disputed joining imagery kept only as a binding undertone
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبَ}} ({{tr:al-kitab}}) is the first explicit object of the first descent. The {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}) field selects writing and prescribing locally, while the disputed joining strand can thicken the image of binding order; the structure places the Book before the Balance as part of the public justice apparatus, with a close formulaic parallel in 42:17.

topics.headline: written prescription as first institution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Book as written prescription that binds public justice, not merely an artifact of inscription.
topics.reason: The rows about definiteness, accusative object position, prescription, disputed joining, kitāb/mīzān pairing, and links to 42:17 and 57:22 survive with the disputed root strand limited.

words.gloss_range: conjunction carrying the object relation from Book to Balance
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the object relation forward from the Book to the Balance. The conjunction creates a two-part civil grammar: revealed text joined to applied measure.

topics.headline: balance co-given with book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Balance is grammatically co-given with the Book, not appended later.
topics.reason: The rows agree that the conjunction links the two accusative objects under the same descent verb.

words.gloss_range: definite singular instrument noun for balance or measure
words.root_gloss_range: weighing, calibration, and measure range, locally narrowed to an operative standard for justice
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمِيزَانَ}} ({{tr:al-mizan}}) completes the descended pair and stands at the threshold of the justice purpose clause. Its {{ar:و ز ن}} ({{tr:w-z-n}}) root keeps a concrete weighing image active, while the instrument pattern makes it the tool or standard by which the Book moves toward public equity; eschatological and cosmic mizan passages color the term without replacing the local social purpose (7:8, 21:47, 23:102-103, 55:7-9, 101:6-8).

topics.headline: measure mediates scripture and justice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees justice grounded in calibrated measure rather than sentiment alone.
topics.reason: The rows support coordinated object status, instrument morphology, physical and moral measure, placement before qist, and wider mīzān echoes, locally narrowed to social calibration.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām governing the subjunctive standing verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the preceding descent into purpose. It does not leave the Book and Balance as static objects; it aims them toward people standing with justice and prepares the later matching purpose lām of disclosure.

topics.headline: purpose of public justice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the descent of Book and Balance aimed at a public human outcome.
topics.reason: The rows identify lām al-taʿlīl before the subjunctive verb and the first member of the two-purpose structure.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect standing verb completed by the justice phrase
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishing, peoplehood, and resurrection range, locally narrowed to active upholding with the bi-l-qist complement
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُومَ}} ({{tr:yaquma}}) is subjunctive after the purpose lām, so human standing is the intended result of revelation. The {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field supplies the upright bodily image, but the following complement narrows it to upholding justice; the sound echo with divine strength at the close keeps human standing under divine power.

topics.headline: standing becomes upholding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the bodily image of standing become a communal act of establishing justice.
topics.reason: The rows support purpose mood, al-nas as subject, bi-l-qist as complement, q-w-m/qist idiom, and q-w echo with qawiyy, with broader resurrection/people senses kept as resonance only.

words.gloss_range: definite collective subject of the justice-standing verb
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability and perception range, locally narrowed to the collective public subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nasu}}) is the public subject of the justice purpose clause. The collective form gathers many people into one responsibility, and the later repeated people-word will recast the same collective as beneficiary of iron rather than source of the standard.

topics.headline: people as justice agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary humanity, not only prophets or elites, assigned the implementation role.
topics.reason: The rows support definite collective subjecthood, agent-to-beneficiary repetition with word 27, and the disputed human root background, narrowed to the local public subject.

words.gloss_range: preposition making justice the medium or standard of standing
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns standing into upholding by attaching it to the justice noun. The preposition makes justice both the medium and standard of the public action.

topics.headline: standing by the standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that justice is not merely nearby; it is the standard by which the standing happens.
topics.reason: The rows identify the preposition between the standing verb and al-qist as the construction that yields uphold/stand with justice.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun for equity as the endpoint of the first purpose clause
words.root_gloss_range: equity and deviation range, locally narrowed to the objective justice standard after measure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقِسْطِ}} ({{tr:al-qist}}) is the endpoint of the first purpose clause after messengers, clear proofs, Book, and Balance have been named. The {{ar:ق س ط}} ({{tr:q-s-t}}) root carries the sharp contrast between equity and deviation, but here the definite noun is pulled by the Balance toward measurable public equity, not loose moral approval.

topics.headline: justice as the first telos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees justice as the declared social endpoint of messengers, proofs, Book, and Balance.
topics.reason: The rows support definiteness, governance by bi, placement after mizan, q-w-m/q-s-t justice idiom, and the root family contrast between justice and injustice.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing the second descent segment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the iron segment while keeping it connected to what came before. The conjunction bridges normative guidance and material force inside one provision chain.

topics.headline: iron woven into justice architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that iron is coordinated with the justice architecture rather than introduced as an unrelated aside.
topics.reason: The rows agree that this conjunction introduces the second anzalna while continuing the provision sequence after the qist clause.

words.gloss_range: repeated Form IV perfect descent with iron as object
words.root_gloss_range: descent/provision range, locally used for divine delivery of material capacity
words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلْنَا}} ({{tr:anzalna}}) repeats the earlier descent verb, now with iron as its object. The {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) root keeps material provision in the same divine economy as guidance, while the missing accompaniment phrase distinguishes iron from the Book-and-Balance delivery with messengers.

topics.headline: second descent without messenger accompaniment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iron dignified by the same descent verb as Book and Balance while structurally separated from messenger accompaniment.
topics.reason: Most rows support repeated divine-agent morphology, iron as object, parallel with word 8, and absence of maahum; the local evidence licenses providential descent but not a scientific claim about extraterrestrial origin.

topics.headline: scientific precision claim not licensed
topics.blocking_evidence: The local grammar and reference evidence license divine descent/provision for iron, but the bundle supplies no scientific source that would let the prose claim astrophysical precision.
topics.reason: The row turns a lexical/theological descent claim into a modern scientific assertion; that exceeds the guardrail evidence available for this word.

words.gloss_range: definite singular material category as the object of descent
words.root_gloss_range: iron, sharpness, and boundary/limit range, locally selected as the material substance with boundary pressure active
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَدِيدَ}} ({{tr:al-hadid}}) is the direct object of the second descent and the surah namesake, giving the justice sequence a material instrument. The {{ar:ح د د}} ({{tr:h-d-d}}) field selects the known metal locally, yet sharpness and limit imagery remain active as the next clause places severe force and public benefits inside it.

topics.headline: iron as force, boundary, and benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iron as the material side of justice: forceful, useful, and boundary-making.
topics.reason: The rows support object status, definiteness, pronoun resumption, title-word significance, h-d-d iron/sharpness/limits field, and integration into text-measure-iron justice infrastructure, narrowed to the local material noun.

words.gloss_range: fronted locative phrase with suffix referring back to iron
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fihi}}) fronts the container before the contents. Its suffix points back to iron, so the clause presents severe force and benefits as properties located in that descended material.

topics.headline: properties located in iron
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that force and benefits are located in iron itself before either property is named.
topics.reason: The rows identify fī plus suffix as referring to iron and fronting the locative before the nominal predicates.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative force or might as the first property in iron
words.root_gloss_range: might, hardship, and punitive force range, locally narrowed to coercive/martial capacity in iron
words.prose: {{ar:بَأْسٌ}} ({{tr:basun}}) is the first named property inside iron, stated in a verbless nominal clause so the force reads as an abiding property rather than a passing event. The {{ar:ب أ س}} ({{tr:b-a-s}}) field brings might and hardship together, and the following adjective intensifies it into severe force; punishment echoes in the wider Quranic baʾs field color the term without making iron itself the punishment (2:211, 6:65, 7:4).

topics.headline: force with hardship inside it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iron first as force that can empower and afflict, not neutral capacity.
topics.reason: The rows support nominal-sentence property status, indefiniteness, pairing with shadid, b-a-s might/misery range, and punishment-field echoes, narrowed to iron’s coercive capacity.

words.gloss_range: indefinite adjective modifying the force noun
words.root_gloss_range: tightening, binding, and intensity range, locally active as severe intensity modifying baʾs
words.prose: {{ar:شَدِيدٌ}} ({{tr:shadidun}}) attaches tightly to the force noun rather than to the benefits, and its indefinite form leaves the severity qualitative and open-ended. The {{ar:ش د د}} ({{tr:sh-d-d}}) root gives intensity the feel of tightening, so iron’s baʾs becomes severe might rather than neutral strength.

topics.headline: force tightened into severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the danger belongs specifically to the force side of iron, not to its benefits.
topics.reason: The rows support agreement with baʾs, lack of al, root intensity, sound texture, and later force-register echoes.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining benefits as a second property of iron
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates benefits with severe force inside the same iron description. The result is a balanced dual property, not a one-sided militarization of iron.

topics.headline: benefits coordinated with force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iron’s severe force counterbalanced by benefits in the same clause.
topics.reason: The rows identify the conjunction as joining manafiʿ to baʾs and balancing the iron clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural benefits as the second property of iron
words.root_gloss_range: benefit, usefulness, and effective penetration range, locally narrowed to practical public utility
words.prose: {{ar:مَنَٰفِعُ}} ({{tr:manafiu}}) stands beside severe force as an equal nominal property of iron. The plural and lack of definiteness leave the uses open-ended, while the {{ar:ن ف ع}} ({{tr:n-f-a}}) root makes benefit active and practical; the following phrase directs those benefits toward people.

topics.headline: many benefits beside might
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees iron’s constructive utility placed on the same grammatical level as its severe force.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination with baʾs, plural indefiniteness, practical utility, beneficiary phrase, and iron’s constructive counterpart, with penetration imagery kept as lexical color.

words.gloss_range: benefactive lām before the human collective
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) introduces the beneficiary of iron’s benefits. It turns utility outward, from a property contained in iron to provision for people.

topics.headline: benefits directed to people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that iron’s benefits are socially directed rather than merely properties of the material.
topics.reason: The rows identify the preposition as marking beneficiary or possession after manafiʿ.

words.gloss_range: genitive definite collective governed by the benefactive preposition
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability and perception range, locally narrowed to the beneficiary collective
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nasi}}) resumes the human collective in a new role. The earlier occurrence made people agents of public justice; here the same collective receives iron’s benefits, framing the middle of the verse as people, justice, iron, people.

topics.headline: same people receive material benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same human collective move from justice agents to recipients of material provision.
topics.reason: The rows support repetition of al-nas, governance by lām, agent-beneficiary contrast with word 15, and the central chiastic human frame, with root dispute kept subordinate.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the iron-benefit segment to the knowledge-test clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) connects the iron-benefit segment to the knowledge-test clause. The verse moves from public provision into the disclosure of who will support God and His messengers unseen.

topics.headline: benefit turns toward testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that material provision leads into disclosure of loyalty rather than ending the verse.
topics.reason: The rows identify the conjunction as linking the iron/benefit segment to li-yaʿlama.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām governing the subjunctive knowing verb with ambiguous attachment scope
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) begins the second purpose clause. Its attachment may lean toward the iron descent or the whole sending-and-descent complex, so the scope stays open, but the payoff is clear: provision becomes a stage for disclosing hidden allegiance, who supports God and His messengers under unseen conditions.

topics.headline: second purpose: disclosure of loyalty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a second telos alongside public justice: the revelation of hidden allegiance.
topics.reason: The rows support lām al-taʿlīl before yaʿlama, parallel with the first purpose lām, and an acknowledged attachment ambiguity.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect knowing verb in the second purpose clause
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, marking, and distinguishing range, locally narrowed to manifesting tested allegiance
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:yalama}}) heads the second purpose clause and takes the supporter class as its object. The {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:a-l-m}}) field keeps knowledge tied to marking or distinction, so the clause is best read as manifesting who supports, in line with testing formulas (3:140, 3:166, 9:16, 47:31).

topics.headline: divine knowing as manifest distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine knowing here as bringing hidden loyalty into manifest distinction, not God acquiring missing information.
topics.reason: The rows support the theological tension around God knowing, the man-clause object, the ʿ-l-m marking field, and Quranic testing parallels, narrowed to disclosure rather than acquisition of knowledge.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as subject of the knowing verb
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with debated etymology, locally fixed as the subject of the test clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allahu}}) is the nominative subject of the knowing clause and the referential anchor for the following support pronouns. The debated divine-name field does not unsettle the syntax: the verse turns from guidance, justice, force, and benefit to God disclosing hidden loyalty before restating the name in the final closure.

topics.headline: God as tester and referent anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the test shift from public order to divine evaluation, with the same referent carried through the following suffixes.
topics.reason: The rows support subject role, theological frame, suffix anchoring, nominative-to-accusative shift with word 39, and echo through the final movement; etymological dispute is kept subordinate to syntax.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun heading the object clause of divine knowing
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) heads the object clause of divine knowing. It keeps the tested group open across persons and times: what is disclosed is whoever supports, not a closed list of names.

topics.headline: the supporter class left open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the test identifies a class of supporters rather than a named group.
topics.reason: The rows identify man as object clause head and controller of the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: imperfect support verb with implicit supporter subject and divine object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: help, support, and victory range, locally active as practical support of God or His cause
words.prose: {{ar:يَنصُرُهُۥ}} ({{tr:yansuruhu}}) makes support the live identifying action of the disclosed group. The {{ar:ن ص ر}} ({{tr:n-s-r}}) root moves the test beyond affiliation into practical assistance, while the suffix creates the paradox of supporting God, or His cause, before the close declares Him strong and mighty; this joins a recurring formula of supporting God (22:40, 47:7, with related patterns at 3:160 and 59:8).

topics.headline: support as active tested loyalty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the loyalty test as active support, with the paradox that humans are said to support the One later named strong and mighty.
topics.reason: The rows support the man-controlled subject, object suffix, indicative/imperfect force, n-s-r active assistance, pronoun ambiguity, theological paradox, and inter-ayah support formula.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the messengers as another object of support
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the support verb to the messengers without repeating the verb. Divine loyalty and prophetic loyalty are kept inseparable in one act of support.

topics.headline: one support spans God and messengers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees support of God and support of His messengers joined under one verb.
topics.reason: The rows agree that the conjunction coordinates rusulahu as an additional object of yanṣuruhu.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural messengers as coordinated object of support
words.root_gloss_range: sending, message, and messenger range, locally narrowed to the plural messenger object of support
words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rusulahu}}) brings the r-s-l field back as the second object of support. The possessive frame shifts from “Our messengers” at the opening to “His messengers” here, and the accepted rusl recitation reinforces the audible bookend without changing the plural messenger referent.

topics.headline: sent messengers become supported messengers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the messenger field return near the close: those sent at the opening are now those to be supported.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination with the support verb, suffix definiteness, pronoun shift, r-s-l three-point arc, qiraat echo with word 4, and unseen-support placement.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the unseen circumstance or medium
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) introduces the unseen phrase after the support objects. It can qualify the act of support or the whole disclosure clause, so the attachment remains open, but either way the test lands in hiddenness rather than performance before an audience.

topics.headline: support under unseen conditions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support test lands in hidden conditions rather than public display.
topics.reason: The rows support manner/circumstance force, attachment ambiguity, and closure of the relative clause with bi-l-ghayb.

words.gloss_range: definite abstract noun for the unseen governed by the preceding preposition
words.root_gloss_range: absence, hiddenness, depth, and setting range, locally narrowed to the unseen condition of support
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghayb}}) names the hidden domain under which support is tested, with the attachment still able to bear on the support act or on the whole disclosure clause. The {{ar:غ ي ب}} ({{tr:gh-y-b}}) root keeps absence and depth active, while the definite abstract noun treats the unseen as a known theological realm; the formula links active support here with broader unseen-reverence passages (2:3, 21:49, 35:18, 36:11, 50:33, 67:12).

topics.headline: the unseen as support condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees unseen loyalty as the criterion after public justice and material provision.
topics.reason: The rows support governance by bi, definiteness, gh-y-b hiddenness range, attachment ambiguity, and formulaic bi-l-ghayb network, narrowed to the local support test.

words.gloss_range: inna particle opening the final emphatic nominal sentence
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the final emphatic nominal sentence. After unseen support, the particle reorients the close from human testing to the theological ground of that test: God’s strength and might.

topics.headline: final emphatic nominal closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the support test grounded immediately in divine strength and invincibility.
topics.reason: The rows identify inna as governing the final divine name and twin predicates, and as the emphatic transition from test clause to closure.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name as the emphatic topic of the closing predication
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with debated etymology, locally fixed as the inna-governed subject of the final clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allaha}}) restates the divine referent after the support pronouns and becomes the accusative topic under the emphatic particle. The name’s final reappearance converts reference back into explicit naming before the paired attributes seal the verse.

topics.headline: divine name restated under inna
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun chain resolve back into explicit divine naming before power is predicated.
topics.reason: The rows support repetition after suffixes, accusative governance by inna, nominative-to-accusative shift from word 31, and theological closure; divine-name dispute remains subordinate.

words.gloss_range: first nominative predicate of the final inna clause
words.root_gloss_range: strength and firmness range, locally active as stable divine strength
words.prose: {{ar:قَوِىٌّ}} ({{tr:qawiyyun}}) is the first predicate of the closing clause, qualitative and predicative rather than merely titular. The {{ar:ق و ي}} ({{tr:q-w-y}}) root answers the support test by denying divine dependency, and it gathers earlier force language: human standing and iron severity are subordinated to God’s own strength.

topics.headline: strength answers the support test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that human support never implies divine need; the One supported is already strong.
topics.reason: The rows support predicate status, indefiniteness as qualitative force, q-w-y strength, echoes with iron severity and yaqūma, and the theological answer to human support.

words.gloss_range: second nominative predicate and final word of the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: might, invincibility, preciousness, and rarity range, locally centered on unovercome divine might with value undertones
words.prose: {{ar:عَزِيزٌ}} ({{tr:azizun}}) completes the twin indefinite predicate closure and the ayah, adding might that remains qualitative rather than a bounded title. The {{ar:ع ز ز}} ({{tr:a-z-z}}) root centers invincible might while retaining preciousness and exalted value as undertones, and the formulaic pair with divine strength places this verse in a wider power-and-victory cadence (11:66, 22:40, 22:74, 33:25, 42:19, 58:21).

topics.headline: mighty close seals the verse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end by making the support test a human disclosure, because God is already unovercome.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination with qawiyy, qualitative predicate form, root valence, final-token force, formulaic qawiyy-aziz pairing, and the denial of divine need.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered sequence of clear signs, book, balance, collective standing in equity, and iron.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence forms a civic chain: disclosure supplies a knowable norm, inscription stabilizes it, weighing makes comparison possible, people undertake its maintenance, and iron gives the arrangement resistant force and practical capacity.

activation_trace.role: Conspicuous disclosure makes the normative starting point publicly inspectable.
Binding inscription converts disclosed meaning into a durable obligation.
An instrument of equitable reckoning supplies the evaluative operation between norm and case.
Rising to an undertaking assigns active implementation to people rather than leaving justice as an object.
Impartial fairness names the social end toward which the preceding operations move.
Resistant metal gives the normative order material durability and enforceability.
Overmastering force supplies coercive capacity when a norm is resisted.
Public usefulness prevents the material term from collapsing into violence alone.

changed_reading.before: A list of revealed gifts followed by the observation that iron is both dangerous and useful.
changed_reading.after: A staged public mechanism in which truth becomes legible, fixed, measured, collectively upheld, and materially effective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: People are to make qist stand beside a balance and benefits explicitly directed to people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The share-and-division branch of qist, joined to weighing and public benefit, permits a distributive reading: collective standing includes maintaining fair portions of material capacity, not only deciding disputes.

activation_trace.role: A due share turns qist into an allocation problem as well as an abstract virtue.
Quantitative appraisal supplies the operation by which portions can be compared.
Ongoing care and oversight make fair allocation a maintained public responsibility.
Benefit directed toward people identifies what the allocation is meant to preserve.

changed_reading.before: Qist means judicial fairness in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Qist can also mean keeping useful material powers in measured, publicly beneficial distribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call for someone to support God and His messengers unseen closes by naming God strong and unassailable.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing attributes block a deficit model of divine support. Hidden human aid instead functions as delegated alignment whose enactment makes the supporter distinguishable.

activation_trace.role: Aid that brings a side into ascendancy supplies the human action being elicited.
Concealment from sight makes the allegiance non-coerced by immediate visibility.
A distinguishing mark lets the purpose clause concern manifested identity rather than bare information.
Concentrated power rules out any need for humans to replenish divine capacity.
Unassailable might closes the verse by containing the apparent dependence created by the call for aid.

changed_reading.before: Humans are asked to add strength to a divine cause that lacks it.
changed_reading.after: Humans are given a hidden arena in which freely enacted alignment marks who will carry an already-undefeated cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior assertions of comprehensive knowledge and sight, together with the immediately preceding declaration of self-sufficiency, turn the focus purpose clause into historical disclosure: hidden allegiance becomes an identifiable deed without supplying God either information or power.

activation_trace.role: The marker branch allows knowing here to function as making a supporter distinguishable.
What is screened from ordinary sight supplies the field in which allegiance must be enacted.
Effective aid is the action through which the hidden commitment acquires a public trace.
Comprehensive prior cognition makes an information-acquisition reading of the later purpose clause unstable.
Insight into human action supplies the context in which conduct is already fully visible.
Self-sufficiency immediately before the focus verse excludes a need-based account of human support.

structural_cues: 57:3-4 place exhaustive knowing and seeing before the later purpose clause.
57:24 declares divine self-sufficiency immediately before 57:25 asks who will support Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior omniscience, visibility of action, self-sufficiency, and a focus branch of knowledge as a distinguishing mark; I infer an arrow from hidden choice to manifested identity. Event-specific actualization, rather than public disclosure, remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The test lets God discover which unseen person will help.
changed_reading.after: The test makes already-known allegiance occur as a differentiating act in history while preserving both divine knowledge and divine needlessness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated spending, delegated succession in possessions, and the condemnation of hoarding activate the allocative branch of qist. Iron's benefits become entrusted material capacity whose circulation must be measured and maintained for people.

activation_trace.role: The due-share sense provides the focus anchor for distributive justice.
Appraisal by weight supplies a concrete procedure for keeping portions accountable.
Benefit for people states the social destination of material capacity.
Release of possessions into expenditure supplies the circulation operation that the focus verse leaves implicit.
Standing in a predecessor's place recasts possession as temporary trusteeship rather than absolute ownership.
Withholding supplies the explicit countermechanism that prevents public benefit from circulating.

structural_cues: Commands to spend recur before the focus verse and are framed by succession in what is held.
57:24 condemns both withholding and its social propagation immediately before iron's benefits are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spending, entrusted succession, withholding, measured shares, and public benefit; I infer that qist governs circulation of material powers. The alternative is that charity and judicial equity remain parallel obligations rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Iron's benefits are neutral utilities adjacent to a general command for justice.
changed_reading.after: Iron's useful capacities are a trust whose measured circulation is itself part of making qist stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent warning about hardened hearts and image of revived earth redistribute hardness within the focus system: resistant severity belongs to the bounded instrument, while the people who wield it must remain responsive to disclosure and capable of renewal.

activation_trace.role: Material resistance gives external institutions the firmness needed to hold a boundary.
Concentrated severity intensifies the instrument's force but does not specify the operator's disposition.
Renewed disclosure supplies the counterforce that keeps human judgment perceptive.
The heart locates the human faculty whose condition determines whether force remains answerable to truth.
Loss of inward softness supplies the failure mode: the operator begins to resemble the hard instrument.
Rain-like revival of dead ground provides the immediate counter-image of recoverable responsiveness.

structural_cues: 57:16 warns that prolonged possession of a book can coincide with hardened hearts.
57:17 immediately answers deadness with revived earth before 57:25 assigns severe strength to iron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward hardening, terrestrial revival, and external metallic severity; I assign the normative arrow that hardness should be housed in accountable instruments rather than cultivated as the agent's character. A simpler contrast between unbelief and belief remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Severe iron endorses severe human operators as the agents of justice.
changed_reading.after: Justice requires hard, bounded capacity outside the self and revivable, disclosure-sensitive hearts in those entrusted to use it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wall with a door, mercy within, and punishment without activates iron's limit-and-prohibition branches. Iron can materialize a calibrated threshold: it separates protected space from harm while a gate preserves controlled passage.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing limit makes iron capable of defining a protected edge rather than only striking an enemy.
Restraining access supplies the exclusion function of the proposed threshold.
Deterrent force makes the boundary effective against breach.
An elevated enclosure supplies the large-scale spatial analogue for iron's boundary function.
An entrance keeps separation from becoming indiscriminate closure by allowing regulated transit.
The interior locates mercy on the protected side of the threshold.
The exposed exterior locates the harmful condition from which the enclosure separates its occupants.

structural_cues: 57:13 explicitly composes wall, door, inside, and outside as one spatial mechanism.
57:25 later places iron after norm and measure, allowing material boundaries to remain answerable to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gated wall with opposed interior and exterior conditions plus iron's boundary branches; I infer an institutional analogy in which measured force controls permeability. The wall may instead remain exclusively eschatological imagery.

changed_reading.before: Iron serves justice chiefly by offensive combat.
changed_reading.after: Iron may serve justice defensively by building enforceable, gated boundaries that shelter mercy without erasing all passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The written placement of events followed by commands against excessive grief and exultation activates the balance as an inward discipline. People can sustain qist only if loss and gain do not continually tilt judgment.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination supplies a stable frame against which volatile outcomes can be received.
Settled, weighty judgment turns the balance inward as resistance to affective skew.
Impartiality is the public result that emotional calibration protects.
The prior inscription of occurrences supplies the contextual basis for receiving outcomes within a larger measure.
Grief and consolation identify one affective extreme that can pull judgment off balance.
Irrecoverable loss supplies the event around which grief can become distorting attachment.
Exultant self-expansion identifies the opposite extreme that can deform measured conduct.

structural_cues: 57:22 moves from occurrence to prior inscription, and 57:23 states the affective consequence.
The balance and standing in qist appear two ayahs later, linking stable reception to public judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written occurrence, loss, grief, and exultation beside the focus balance; I infer that affective steadiness enables impartial action. The live alternative treats 57:22-23 as consolation without procedural implications for qist.

changed_reading.before: The balance is only an external device for judging acts or commodities.
changed_reading.after: The balance also images disciplined reception of loss and gain, an inward condition for people to uphold impartial justice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel follows successive traces, then contrasts an invented discipline with what was not prescribed and reports failure of proper care. The focus apparatus is therefore not self-executing: each generation must transmit, audit, and maintain its ends rather than trust inherited forms or founding zeal.

activation_trace.role: Successive batches make messenger transmission a temporal chain rather than a single delivery.
Durable prescription supplies the standard against which inherited practice can be audited.
Care and continuing oversight make standing in qist an ongoing maintenance task.
Following one trace after another supplies the explicit succession mechanism after the focus verse.
The alternate mapped inventory independently preserves the image of tracking a predecessor's course.
A remaining sign of what preceded gives later communities evidence but not automatic fidelity.
Unprecedented institution-making supplies the possibility that a transmitted community adds a new form.
The denial of prescribed inscription separates inherited obligation from a form people originated themselves.
Attentive maintenance supplies the criterion by which even a sincerely founded practice succeeds or fails.

structural_cues: 57:26-27 immediately continue the messenger-and-book sequence through descendants and repeated following.
57:27 distinguishes an unprescribed innovation from its stated aim and then judges the failure to maintain it rightly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, residual traces, prescription, innovation, and failed care; I infer that 57:25 describes an institution requiring intergenerational maintenance and audit. The alternative confines 57:27's failure to that particular ascetic practice.

changed_reading.before: Once book, balance, and iron are delivered, the justice system is established.
changed_reading.after: The delivered system remains contingent on repeated, right care; inherited or newly invented forms can preserve its end, drift from it, or fail through neglect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries support from aid in conflict into rain, drainage, and cultivation, then gives iron a waterworks role. It remains anchored in the focus support root's rain and watercourse branches, iron's stated benefits, and the context's revived earth and rain-grown plant; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material possibility, not as a claim that iron literally denotes irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins support, iron, and benefits for people, while the support inventory includes rain relief and channels feeding collected water.

activation_trace.role: Rain-like relief broadens support from defeating an opponent to restoring a community's life conditions.
Channels arriving from afar supply a hydrological mechanism for gathering and directing relief.
Durable metal supplies the material capacity for tools, gates, or channels within the exploratory mechanism.
Public benefit anchors the proposed works in the verse's explicit human-facing utility.
Revival of ground by rain and growth supplies the ecological outcome of successful support.
Descending rain provides the input that material systems can catch and distribute.
The alternate mapped branch confirms rain as relief while preserving the split-root evidence.
Vegetation emerging from soil provides the visible benefit produced by water reaching land.
Dry matter breaking apart warns that life-giving benefit is temporal and requires renewed provision.

changed_reading.before: Supporting the messengers with iron primarily evokes armed defense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, support can include rain-like relief and durable public works that turn water into shared life, with the plant cycle exposing their need for renewal.

strongest_changes: The purpose clause becomes manifestation of hidden allegiance rather than acquisition of missing divine knowledge.
Book, balance, and iron become an integrated but maintained public system of norm, measure, boundary, force, and utility.
Qist expands into stewardship and circulation of material benefits, with withholding as its countermechanism.
Hardness is assigned to bounded instruments while the people operating them must remain revivable and perceptive.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activation came from the nearby spending-and-withholding sequence, the wall-and-door spatial mechanism, hardened hearts followed by revived earth, and the post-focus failure of intergenerational care. Together they made material governance and maintenance visible without reducing iron to warfare.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the wall-and-door mechanism should inform earthly institutions or remain an eschatological analogy.
Whether the due-share branch of qist licenses a specifically distributive reading here beyond general fairness.
The rain-and-waterworks reading of support remains branch-grounded but form-distant.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Clear signs, measure, and public standing form one justice apparatus.** ب ي ن B005 is disclosing meaning by sign; و ز ن B002 is scale of justice and equity and B003 balancing two things; ق و م B003 is rising to undertake a matter and B008 uprightness; ق س ط B001 is justice. The purpose clause explicitly assigns people the active role. The packet supplies disclosure + standard + standing; I infer intelligible norm and measure -> coordinated public action. The ayah reads revelation as institution-building, not only private instruction.
2. **Iron supplies both boundary and force under measure.** ح د د B001 is boundary/limiting edge, B004 iron and resistant hardness, and B005 sharp penetration; ب ء س B001 is severe force or punishment. The iron clause follows balance and equity. The packet supplies material force after norm; I infer bounded coercive capacity -> protection of the measured order. Iron is neither autonomous violence nor mere commodity.
3. **Unseen support makes hidden allegiance effective.** ن ص ر B001 is aid that makes someone prevail and B002 redress after oppression; غ ي ب B001 is hidden from sight or knowledge. The test clause joins support to absence of direct visibility. The packet supplies unseen condition + aid; I infer action without visible compulsion -> disclosure of allegiance. Divine knowledge here reads as enacted manifestation of who will support the justice mechanism.
4. **Strength is rope-like assembly.** ق و ي B001 is assembled strength like rope strands; ع ز ز B004 is reinforcing and strengthening. The closing pair follows plural messengers, people, instruments, and supporters. The packet supplies coordinated components; I infer assembled relations -> effective strength. The conclusion reads as power capable of integrating differentiated means.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:26–27 tests this apparatus historically: transmission can preserve book and guidance while communities still diverge or fail to guard self-imposed forms. That later sequence corrects any automatic-institution reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Three placed components of public order.** Repeated `ن ز ل` activates **B004**, placing something in its proper order, as well as **B002** sending down. `ك ت ب` **B001/B002** joins norms into writing, `و ز ن` **B002** supplies the scale of justice, and `ح د د` **B001/B004** supplies boundary plus resistant iron. The packet supplies book, scale, and iron under the same descent verb; I infer a functional stack: articulation, measurement, and boundary enforcement. “Sent down” therefore reads as coordinated placement into social order, not one undifferentiated material motion.
2. **Justice must make a people stand.** `ق و م` **B002/B003** supplies upright rising and resolve to undertake a matter, while **B009** supplies what sustains a thing; `ق س ط` **B001/B004** supplies equitable shares and the straight balance, reinforced by `و ز ن` **B003** alignment. The packet's purpose construction makes public standing the outcome of these instruments. I infer that justice is successful only when it enables sustained collective agency. The ayah thus reads equity as load-bearing social posture, not an abstract verdict.
3. **Hard force is bounded by benefit and tested without spectacle.** `ح د د` **B002/B005** supplies prevention and keen penetration, `ب ء س` **B001** severe force, and `ن ف ع` **B001** benefit; `ن ص ر` **B001** assigns aid the role of making another prevail, while `غ ي ب` **B001** removes it from sight. The packet juxtaposes force, benefits, and unseen aid; I infer that iron's coercive capacity is legitimate here only as a bounded servant of benefit and equity, and that unseen support reveals choice without visible compulsion. `ق و ي` **B001** then pictures strength as assembled rope-strands and `ع ز ز` **B004** as reinforcement: the close reads as coordinated strength, not isolated violence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:26–27 corrected any mechanically institutional reading: lineage can house book and prophecy while many leave the covering, and a sincere institution can fail in custody. 57:28's walking light then showed the intended result of book, messenger, and boundary as guided movement, while 57:29 denied that custodians own the bounty.

baseline.text: Elçilerimizi açık kanıtlarla gönderdik; insanların adaleti ayakta tutmaları için onlarla birlikte kitabı ve ölçüyü indirdik. Demiri de indirdik; onda büyük bir güç ve insanlar için yararlar vardır. Böylece Allah, kendisine ve elçilerine görmeden kimin yardım ettiğini bilsin. Allah güçlüdür, mutlak üstündür.

findings.text: Açık kanıt, kitap, ölçü ve insanların ayağa kalkması tek bir kamusal adalet düzeni kurar: anlaşılır ilke, dengeli ölçüm ve ortak eylem birbirini tamamlar.
Demirin büyük gücü bağımsız şiddet değildir; sınır, direnç ve yarar özellikleriyle ölçülü adalet düzenini korumak üzere kısıtlanmış bir kuvvettir.
Allah'a ve elçilerine görünmeden yardım etmek, görünür zorlamanın yokluğunda seçilen bağlılığı etkili eyleme dönüştürerek açığa çıkarır.
Ayetin sonundaki güç, farklı araçları, insanları ve destekçileri bir ipin lifleri gibi birleştirip birbirini pekiştiren örgülü bir kuvvet olarak belirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Not depriving people of their due and not spreading corruption extends balanced dealing into social consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger is named witness, bearer of good news, and warner, reinforcing public messenger-mediated accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately following command to make protective armor and measure its links directly develops iron's useful, ordered force.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Book is sent in truth for people, giving a close secondary parallel to revelation's public human purpose.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to believe in every sent Book and to establish justice among people is one of the closest missing parallels to the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Equivalent redress and forgiveness constrain response to wrongdoing, providing a justice boundary for force.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Helping God is explicitly paired with divine help and firm footing, directly illuminating the focus's support relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Collective force against transgression is limited by reconciliation with justice and equity, a close parallel to constrained severe might.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directed distribution of resources prevents their confinement among the wealthy, extending the focus's public-benefit and justice horizon.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Kindness and justice toward non-hostile others set a social boundary against indiscriminate force.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A united, ordered rank offers a secondary collective-strength parallel to the focus's weak braided-force reading.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The call to be helpers of God, exemplified by the disciples, directly parallels support of God and His messengers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A messenger recites signs and teaches the Book and wisdom among an unlettered community, strongly developing the focus's guidance-to-public-action sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The clear proof is a messenger reciting purified scriptures, directly uniting proof, messenger, and written revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Killing those who command justice among people supplies a contrary reception boundary for the focus's public qist.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Fighting for the oppressed presents force as rescue from wrongful domination, a direct protective-force parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger comes to clarify from the Book what had been concealed, extending the focus's intelligible guidance function.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A messenger arrives after an interval to clarify, making public responsibility depend on delivered communication.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger's public command of good, prohibition of harm, and removal of burdens give a secondary social-benefit account of messengership.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shu'ayb's warning against diminishing measure and balance adds the missing prophetic summons that frames the fuller command in 11:85.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Book is sent as clarification, guidance, mercy, and good news, a broad but relevant account of revelation's public function.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Guiding leaders are linked to enacted good, prayer, and almsgiving, offering a secondary model of accountable public guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses' Book is described as insights, guidance, and mercy after prior destruction, extending its public corrective role.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger calls to God by permission and serves as an illuminating lamp, supporting the communicative side of clear proof.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: David is commanded to judge among people with truth and not follow desire, one of the closest missing judicial parallels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A prescribed way is set in place and contrasted with uninformed desire, supporting guidance as an operative public path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The warning against those who defraud in measure adds a direct accountability boundary to the focus's balance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Taking full measure for oneself while withholding from others exposes the reciprocal injustice that balanced measure prevents.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Defrauding others when measuring or weighing completes the explicit contrary case to equitable balance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tutulan bir canlı veya denetlenen bir güç üzerindeki engel kaldırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.

Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, aceleyi bırakıp ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yukarıdan aşağı inmeyi, araçtan inmeyi, yağmurun düşmesini, bir yerde konaklamayı ve ağır ağır inmeyi birlikte açıkça destekler. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hareket ve yerleşme alanını doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel iniş ile bir yerde konaklama birlikte korunmalı; ettirgen indirme, konuk ağırlama ve savaş kullanımları bu dala katılmamalıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey yukarıdan aşağı hareket eder veya üzerinde bulunduğu araçtan ayrılır.
Hareket, bir yere varıp yükünü bırakarak orada konaklama sonucuna uzanır.
Yağmurun gökten düşmesi, aşağı yönlü hareketin doğal bir örneğidir.
İniş, bir anda değil ağır ağır ve aşamalı biçimde gerçekleşebilir.

Tanrısal bildiri bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılabilir.
Tanrısal esirgemenin bir topluluğa erişmesi bu ulaştırma biçiminin örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konaklanan yer, su başı ve ev anlamlarını; soyut olarak dereceyi; ayrıca insanları konak yerlerine yerleştirme ve birini derecesinden düşürme eylemlerini açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu yer ve derece uzantılarını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yer veya derece sonucu merkezdedir; sırf aşağı hareket etme ve konuğa yiyecek hazırlama bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yer ve derece adları ile insanları konak yerlerine yerleştiren yapıya bağlı eylemler ayrılır; yerleştirme kullanımı bütün yalın biçimlere yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların indiği ve kaldığı ev, durak ya da su başı gibi bir yerdir; soyut uzantıda kişinin veya şeyin bulunduğu dereceyi anlatır. İnsanlar bu yerlere yerleştirilebilir, bir kişinin derecesi de aşağı çekilebilir.

facets.statement: İnilen ve kalınan yer, ev, durak veya su başı olarak adlandırılır.
Somut yer düşüncesi, kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu dereceye aktarılır.
Bir topluluk, kendisi için belirlenen konak yerlerine yerleştirilebilir.
Bir kimsenin bulunduğu derece aşağı çekilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı konaklanan yeri ev ve su başına kadar genişletir, buradan soyut derece anlamına geçer; topluluğa konak yeri belirleme ve kişiyi derecesinden düşürme de bu iki alanın eylem biçimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Somut yer ile ondan gelişen soyut dereceyi birlikte göstermek gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Konaklanan yeri ve bu yer düşüncesinden gelişen derece anlamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, durak, su başı veya insanların sıkça indiği yer anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Ev, durak ve su başı gibi somut konaklama yerlerini dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana bölümü bir şeyi düzenleyip kendi yerine koymayı destekler; ancak aynı ifade bölüm bölüm ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırma kullanımını da taşır. Dal korunabilir, fakat bu ikinci kullanım çekirdekle özdeşleştirilmeden ayrı bir kaynak çeşitlemesi olarak belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uygun yere veya sıraya koyma çekirdektir; bölüm bölüm ulaştırma yalnızca açıkça desteklenen özel kullanımda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın düzenleme ve yerine koyma anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki bildiri yapıları bu yalın çekirdeğe ancak ayrı bir kaynak çeşitlemesi olarak bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi düzenleyerek ona uygun görülen yere, sıraya veya dereceye koymaktır. Aynı biçim, belirli bir bildirim bağlamında içeriği bölüm bölüm ve yineleyerek ulaştırmayı da anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey düzenlenir ve kendisine uygun yere, sıraya veya dereceye konur.
Belirli bildirim bağlamında içerik parçalara ayrılarak ve tekrar tekrar ulaştırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek ve yol azığını çekirdek yapar; konuğun kendisini, ürün gelirini, fazlalığı, bağışı ve birikmiş payı buna bağlı kullanımlar olarak açıkça verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi çekirdeği ve benzetmeli uzantıları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Konuk için hazırlanan pay çekirdektir; yer, derece ve savaş anlamları dışarıda, gelir ve bağış anlamları ise bağlı uzantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yiyecek, pay, gelir ve konuk adları ile konuk etme ve bolluk bildiren yapılar ayrı ayrı korunur; yapıya bağlı bolluk anlamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuğun geldiğinde yararlanması için önceden hazırlanan yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payıdır. Bu çekirdekten konuğun kendisi, ürün geliri, fazlalık, bağış ve bir araya gelmiş pay anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Konuğun yararlanması için yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payı hazırlanır.
Hazırlanan payla ilişkili olarak konuk kişinin kendisi de adlandırılır.
Hazır pay düşüncesi ürün geliri, fazlalık, bereket ve bağış anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir araya toplanmış pay, konuk için hazırlanmış toplu yiyeceğe benzetilerek anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek, azık ve ağırlamayı temel alır; konuk adı, ürün geliri ve fazlalığı, bol verme, topluluğun geçim payları ve birikmiş pay bu hazırlık düşüncesinden gelişir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlara veya bir topluluğa zamanın akışı içinde gelip çatan ağır sıkıntıyı ve bunun çoğulunu açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi olayın ağırlığını, dışarıdan gelişini ve etkilenen insanları doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam başa gelen ağır bir sıkıntıyla sınırlıdır; sıradan fiziksel iniş ya da konuk için hazırlanan pay bu dala girmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların ya da bir topluluğun başına zamanın akışı içinde gelip çatan ağır bir sıkıntı veya yıkıcı olaydır.

error_profile.preserves: Başa gelen olayın ağır ve yıkıcı niteliğini güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Her ağır sıkıntının mutlaka yıkıcı felaket boyutunda olmayabileceği ayrımını daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sıkıntının insanlara veya bir topluluğa gelip çatmasını açıkça öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal zamanın değişen ve sert dönüşlerini de genel kapsamına alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Zamanın getirdiği ağır sıkıntı ve sarsıcı olay iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir ağır olayın başa gelmesine, komşu dal ise ağır olayların yanında zamanın sert dönüşlerine de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal olayın ağır bir sıkıntı olmasını ve insanlara çarpmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal zamanın yeni ortaya çıkan olaylarını, sıkıntılı olsun olmasın, daha geniş biçimde kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Beklenmedik olaylar ve zamanın sıkıntıları iki dalda kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız ağır ve başa gelen sıkıntıdır; komşu dalın olay ve yenilik kapsamı daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal zamanın getirdiği ağır olayın başa gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sınama amacı taşıyan rahatlık durumunu ve mal ya da çocukla sınanmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanı zorlayan bela, sıkıntı ve acı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağır olayın gelişine bağlıdır; komşu dal güçlük kadar rahatlığın da sınama olması yönünü içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tek tek başa gelen ağır olayları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal zamanın bütün sarsıntılarını çoğul ve mecazlı bir anlatımla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Zamanın insanlara getirdiği şiddetli güçlükler aynı anlam alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olay türünün adıdır; komşu dal zamanın sıkıntılarını sarsıntı benzetmesiyle topluca anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen dört komşu ağır olay, zaman olayı, sınanma ve zamanın sıkıntıları arasındaki temel kapsam farklarını gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النازلة والنوازل، أي الشدة التي تنزل بالقوم أو بالناس من شدائد الدهر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق النزول المكاني ولا النزل المعد للضيف.
